name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
steps: Slice the beef thinly against the grain.
Stir-fry the beef in hot oil until just browned, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli and garlic until bright green and tender-crisp.
Return the beef to the pan and pour over the oyster sauce and soy sauce.
Toss until glossy and serve over the hot rice.
